summary: Layer 1B expands the optical-interconnect upstream node around scarce qualified inputs rather than transceiver assemblers. The strongest underfollowed line is indium phosphide substrate and epitaxy capacity, where AXTI appears directly exposed but still needs filing-level verification of customer qualification, capacity, and AI datacenter revenue linkage. Tower Semiconductor is a higher-cap silicon-photonics foundry-capacity candidate. MKS is a more indirect equipment/subsystem proxy into wafer fabrication and potentially photonics-related process capacity. Coherent is included as a reference anchor because it sits closer to lasers, optical materials, and transceiver demand, but it is not the main underfollowed target.
